subject: Quarter-end reflection: annotated scorecard, key evidence & leader asks
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quarter-end reflection: annotated scorecard, key evidence & leader asks

Team,

Attached is my pass at the Q4 annotated scorecard and a short evidence pack for the items where we're most likely to be challenged in QBR. Highlights up front:

- Overall confidence: green for Serving Runtime stability, yellow for Dedicated capacity uptake, red for Optimize adoption vs forecast.
- Primary disputes: two objective calibrations where engineering output and platform adoption diverge (see Item 2 and Item 5 in the spreadsheet).
- Evidence I linked: ticket latencies, hosting commits, customer usage graphs, and the Acquire pilot SLO notes.

Asks before EOD:
1) Laura — please validate the revenue signal we used to move the Dedicated adoption from 32% -> 38% (line 14). If we keep 32%, we change the narrative and the ask to Sales.
2) Vivek — I annotated a proposed mitigation path for Optimize (page 3). Can you confirm that the suggested Q1 play (quantization enablement + batching defaults) is realistic from an engineering roadmap perspective?
3) Marissa — review the customer-facing evidence for Acme (attached) and flag anything that might require legal/contractual review before we present in the QBR.

I'll collect feedback and produce a final package for the exec QBR deck by 17:00 PT. If you have quick thumbs-up / objections, reply inline.

Thanks — Steph

--
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachments: 2026Q4_OKR_score_rubric_v3.xlsx (worksheet: annotated_scores), evidence-pack-links.txt (list of Drive links), presentation-QBR-deck-draft.pdf (starter slides)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-06T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter-end reflection: annotated scorecard, key evidence & leader asks

Steph — quick read, thank you. Two quick points:

1) Revenue signal for Dedicated: the 38% figure used the preliminary forecast from SalesOps that included renewals but excluded expected churn from the Acquire pilot. If we want conservative public-facing numbers, revert to 32% and call out the upside in the notes. I'll attach the SalesOps export in a follow-up.
2) Item 5 (Optimize adoption) — we should separate "adoption" from "impact". Adoption is the number of repos/projects enabling Optimize; impact is the measured cost-per-token delta. I agree with the red call, but recommend we present a pathway with an explicit metric (adoption → % cost reduction target by EoQ1).

I'll sign off on the language if we adjust the Revenue line and add the adoption→impact metric.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Strategy | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-06T10:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter-end reflection: annotated scorecard, key evidence & leader asks

Thanks Steph — good, concise pack. A couple of replies inline:

- On feasibility of the Q1 play: the two things that must happen are (1) a small refactor to expose quantization knobs in the serving runtime (PRs queued, estimated 2-3 sprints) and (2) an enablement plan for top 10 customers (workshop + sample config). Both are feasible but will need a small cross-functional pod (runtime eng, platform eng, solutions). I estimate a 60% chance to hit the early adoption target by EoQ1.
- Resource ask: if we want to accelerate to 80% chance, we need a dedicated 0.5 FTE from runtime and 0.5 FTE from solutions for Q1.

I'll add a short note in the sheet about the dependency and proposed pod. Also — we should add an explicit rollback/fallback in the narrative for customers who see regressions after quantization.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
CTO | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-06T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarter-end reflection: annotated scorecard, key evidence & leader asks

Hi Steph / Laura — thanks for the transparency. A couple quick notes from Acme's perspective that might be useful in the QBR:

- The Acquire pilot churn estimate (that impacted Dedicated adoption) was driven by a config mismatch on our side — that's now resolved. You can treat the Acme contribution as "recovered upside" for the adoption number if you want, but please mark it as "post-close risk mitigated" and show evidence.
- For Optimize: we'd love to be in the trial cohort. Jordan (Acme) can commit to a 6-week pilot. Please coordinate with Marissa for legal/ops review.

Jordan

--
Jordan Ellis
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
jordan.ellis@acme.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quarter-end reflection: annotated scorecard, key evidence & leader asks

Thanks all — quick capture of decisions and next steps: 

- Revenue number: Laura to revert Dedicated adoption to 32% for the public QBR slide; annotate the 38% as an upside scenario with SalesOps export attached. (Laura)
- Optimize narrative: Vivek to add a short feasibility note and resource ask; include rollback plan. We'll present it as "pilot-ready" with the requested 0.5+0.5 FTE ask as optional. (Vivek)
- Customer evidence: Marissa to run Acme's evidence through Legal/Contracts (Jordan's note confirmed recoverable). Marissa, coordinate with Jordan on the 6-week pilot onboarding timeline. (Marissa)
- Action owner for final QBR packet: Steph will produce final slides and the annotated scorecard with in-line evidence links by 17:00 PT.

If anyone wants to raise an objection to the above captures, reply-all within the hour. Otherwise I'll close the loop and publish to the exec folder.

Appended: quick excerpt from the rubric used to assign scores (for transparency) and a pointer to the evidence pack.

Cheers — Steph

--
